summary: The house at the center of a permit fight is already standing while the appeal is still pending.
realLife: While the Coastal Commission’s appeal was pending in state court, the Nollans replaced the bungalow and bought the property without notifying the commission of the work.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with house, appeal, owner. A reporter returning to the block can see the new house while the access dispute is still unresolved.

turns.what: A buyer asks about access while the appeal is still open.
turns.pulledBy: The property is listed for sale before the court issues its decision.
turns.writesBack: The owner passes the pending case information to the buyer.

turns.what: An inspector signs off on the new house while the access dispute remains on the court calendar.
turns.pulledBy: The inspection covers construction and makes no finding about passage along the beach.
turns.writesBack: The property file records a completed inspection alongside the open appeal.
